summary: DOM core received a broad set of correctness, security, and performance improvements: Firefox now handles node adoption, ranges, animated elements, image sizing, fullscreen documents, printing visibility, and clipboard provenance more reliably. It also expands web-platform support with Permissions Policy, SpeechRecognition telemetry and cross-origin handling, conservative speculation-rule prefetching, and improved Reporting and Sanitizer behavior. **These changes make navigation, editing, accessibility-related events, and embedded content more predictable while reducing avoidable work and leaks.**
